name: Acceptance test 22C - unsupported policy Version warned/blocked, never silently rewritten
note: IAM-704 version gate. A legacy Version 2008-10-17 was previously accepted silently and analyzed under 2012-10-17 grammar. The engine fails closed with a UNSUPPORTED_POLICY_VERSION coverage block when the 2008 document uses a policy variable (2008 treats ${...} as literal text; since v1.3.0 a variable-free 2008 document is analyzed as 2012-10-17, R5-3). The version is NEVER silently rewritten: the parsed model preserves version '2008-10-17' verbatim, and no findings are produced under an unvalidated grammar. (22A malformed JSON and 22B missing Effect/Action stay hard validation failures elsewhere; this fixture covers 22C only.)
